title: It looks like Apple's next-generation AirPods will launch in 2019 (AAPL)
text: It looks like Apple's next-generation AirPods will launch in 2019 (AAPL) Monday, 3 December 2018 ( 2 hours ago ) · Apple won't release new wireless-charging enabled AirPods headphones until early next year, according to a prediction from well-known analyst Ming-Chi Kuo. · AirPods will get an "all-new" design in 2020, according to the note. · "We believe that there is a greater likelihood of legacy iPhone users buying AirPods than ...
